correctness.rationale: For N=n,L=i, exactly h-1 earlier i draws and final i, hence the multinomial coefficient extraction from exp(p0 z) times other truncated exponentials, valid n>=mh. The coefficient factors p^r/r!, supported on r>=h, and the null exponential are log-concave; their convolutions retain TP2. For p_j>p_i the rank kernel a_pj(r)/a_pi(r) grows strictly in r; a positive 2x2 determinant using the minimal supported coefficient b_(m-2)h yields strict monotonicity of C_k(pj)/C_k(pi) for all k>= (m-1)h, not merely asymptotic monotonicity. n=mh uniform final-label law follows from equal exact quota counts. Conditioning on fixed h-1 instances of i proves the fixed-parameter joint tail and stated odds ratio. Recomputed bounded exact-rational unequal-weight examples with and without null outcomes, supporting but not replacing the all-n proof.

value.rationale: The last required coupon label, conditional on observed completion time, is a natural inferential observable distinct from the classical marginal collection-time distribution. Strict ordering with arbitrary weights, repeated quotas and optional nulls answers a nontrivial uniform-in-n comparison and supplies a sharp interpretive distinction; it is not just a re-expression of the known total-time EGF.

limitations: Finite independent identical draws only; common positive integer quota; no varying quotas or adaptive sampling.
Exact-rational enumerations are illustrations, not infinite-n proof.
